tclsh: an `if {0}` arm never runs; the fold is a constant branch (I230) and O107 must not fire on the same arm. Routed to dataflow
Contract: a rebased CFG equals a fresh build of the shifted source (the analysis-performance session accepted the three rebase rows: memoised receipts)
Tcl: a braced word is not substituted, so `[...]` text inside it never runs (Tcl(n) rule 6)
Registry rule: an alias to a user procedure carries that procedure's behaviour, not the registry traits of its spelling
tclsh: a value the try header's handler may rewrite cannot fold a later branch; no constant branches on either side (vacuous comparison until the untrust lands)

Ruling of 17 November: re-point at the observable, a module that shadows a command is not served another module's lattice (same text, different trust, different answer, memo on). "The memo stays on" goes to analysis-performance's ledger.
